observations: The package contains the exact 269-byte P01116 SV=1 FASTA, deterministic JSON and CSV analyses, Codex-authored provenance, the data-rich SVG preview, and an embedded member manifest.
All six ZIP members have fixed timestamps, permissions, order, byte counts, and SHA-256 digests.
The build reopens the ZIP and verifies every member byte string after writing.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the retained task-chooser-ready message.
The 2026-08-30 Viewer review retained no successful Sequence Viewer operation; failed and unexecuted actions are mapped in outputs/viewer-operation-evidence.json.
interpretation: Exact member metadata connects the public source, calculations, provenance, and visual summary in one independently inspectable package.
limitations: The sequence calculations are descriptive and do not establish experimental function.
Sequence Viewer open, analysis, export, and query operations are rehearsed.
The ZIP was produced by local Python and is not a viewer-published artifact.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not produce a scientific result or package member.
No Sequence Viewer capability is claimed because the server-created sessions never produced a query-confirmed mounted viewer.

provenance.note: Local Python assembled and verified the ZIP; Codex published it; outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json records the genuine launcher invocation.
